mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.INSTID, T.INSTTASKID, T.USERID CANDIDATORID, T.ROLEID, T.TASKUSERID, T.TASKROLEID FROM (SELECT U.USERID, U.ID TASKUSERID, NULL TASKROLEID, U.INSTTASKID, U.INSTID, NULL ROLEID FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_USER U UNION ALL SELECT U.USERID, NULL TASKUSERID, R.ID TASKROLEID, R.INSTTASKID, R.INSTID, R.ROLEID FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_ROLE R, T_CORE_ROLE_USER U, T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK K, T_CORE_BPMN_INST I WHERE R.ROLEID = U.ROLEID AND K.ID = R.INSTTASKID AND I.ID = K.INSTID AND (K.COUNTERSIGN = '0' /* 会签时所有人员都要进行审核 */ OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT C WHERE C.CREATEDTIME >= K.CREATEDTIME AND C.TASKID = K.TASKID AND C.TARGETID = I.TARGETID AND U.USERID = C.USERID))) T WHERE T.INSTID IN
#{id}

SELECT DISTINCT T.INSTTASKID, T.USERID CANDIDATORID FROM (SELECT U.INSTID, U.USERID, U.INSTTASKID FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_USER U UNION ALL SELECT R.INSTID, U.USERID, R.INSTTASKID FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_ROLE R, T_CORE_ROLE_USER U, T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK K, T_CORE_BPMN_INST I WHERE R.ROLEID = U.ROLEID AND K.ID = R.INSTTASKID AND I.ID = K.INSTID AND (K.COUNTERSIGN = '0' /* 会签时所有人员都要进行审核 */ OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT C WHERE C.CREATEDTIME >= K.CREATEDTIME AND C.TASKID = K.TASKID AND C.TARGETID = I.TARGETID AND U.USERID = C.USERID))) T WHERE T.INSTID IN
#{id}

SELECT DISTINCT T.TASKID, T.TASKNAME, T.CANDIDATORID, T.CANDIDATORNAME FROM (SELECT K.INSTID, U.INSTTASKID TASKID, K.TASKNAME, U.USERID CANDIDATORID, CU.USERNAME CANDIDATORNAME FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_USER U, T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK K, T_CORE_USER CU WHERE U.INSTTASKID = K.ID AND U.USERID = CU.ID AND CU.STATUS <> 'deprecated' UNION ALL SELECT K.INSTID, R.INSTTASKID TASKID, K.TASKNAME, U.USERID CANDIDATORID, CU.USERNAME CANDIDATORNAME FROM T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK_ROLE R, T_CORE_ROLE_USER U, T_CORE_BPMN_INST_TASK K, T_CORE_BPMN_INST I, T_CORE_USER CU WHERE R.ROLEID = U.ROLEID AND K.ID = R.INSTTASKID AND I.ID = K.INSTID AND U.USERID = CU.ID AND CU.STATUS <> 'deprecated' AND (K.COUNTERSIGN = '0' /* 会签时所有人员都要进行审核 */ OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_BPMN_COMMENT C WHERE C.CREATEDTIME >= K.CREATEDTIME AND C.TASKID = K.TASKID AND C.TARGETID = I.TARGETID AND U.USERID = C.USERID))) T WHERE T.INSTID IN
#{id}
